title: Marginal and Average Tax Rates, 2026
units: Percent of earnings, married couple with two children
source: Internal Revenue Service; PolicyEngine US (2.43.0); author's calculations.
note: Federal income tax after the EITC and child tax credit, plus the employee's payroll taxes. One earner, all income from wages; children under 17. Marginal rate: tax on the next $1,000 earned.
